name: @fasaled/muin
description: A command-line tool (TUI + REPL) that represents the internal structure of a PDF file — indirect objects, streams, page tree, cross-references — as a navigable graph.
author: Francisco Sánchez <fa.sl@live.com>

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format esm --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build ../core/src/worker/session-worker.ts --outfile dist/session-worker.js --target node --format esm
